Parse Hive DDL without recovery

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"sql\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'\nLOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'\nTBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.language)
debugPrint(result.metrics.errorCount)
debugPrint(result.metrics.totalBytes)
debugPrint(result.structure)
debugPrint(result.structure[0].name as Any)
```
